fix1_atomic_pre_submission_persistence.finding: execute_signal_Cycle() generates idem_key on line 2270 and persists it to disk via mark_a2_leg_order_submitting(), but lines 2282-2286 call adapter.place_market_order() WITHOUT passing idempotency_key=idem_key. ExnessTraderAPIClient.submit_order() therefore generates a random UUID client_request_id, breaking correlation between the persisted pending reservation and the broker order/ack.

fix2_broker_history_reconciliation.finding: reconcile_or_initialize_a2_leg_state() queries TradeMemoryService with track='LT_STRUCTURE_EURUSD_A2' (line 1063), whereas broker order/deal history (lines 1044-1058) is account-wide across all strategies. Any historical EURUSD trade on the same account from an earlier strategy track (e.g. 'Forex Long-Term (EURUSD)' or 'LONGTERM_STRUCTURE') is excluded from tm_by_ticket/tm_deal_ids/tm_order_ids, causing untracked_broker_deals/untracked_broker_orders to falsely trigger UNTRACKED_EURUSD_BROKER_DEAL_HISTORY_DETECTED or MISSING_STATE_UNRECONCILABLE_BROKER_HISTORY.

fix3_terminal_operation_reconciliation.finding: 1) Line 842 accesses self._reconciled_fill_tickets without calling self.ensure_post_fill_guard(), raising AttributeError on a fresh instance. 2) Lines 871-895 match any single untracked EURUSD position on the snapshot with the same side (len(eur_open) == 1) without verifying volume, open_time, or price proximity; Probe D proved that a pre-existing unrelated 0.50-lot EURUSD position at 1.06000 is falsely bound to a 0.03-lot A2 operation at 1.08100. 3) When a position opens and immediately closes before reconciliation (Probe E), open_positions is empty and Exness /v1/history/accounts/{id}/deals & /orders do not include operation_id or client_request_id, so cand_deals and cand_orders remain empty.

fix4_deal_ledger.finding: In process_broker_fill_response(), TradeMemoryService.record_trade() (line 1995) opens and commits its own SQLite connection first, and then lines 2031-2076 open a second separate SQLite connection (dl_conn) to insert into a2_deal_ledger inside the same try/except block. Probe G proved that if the second connection fails (e.g. SQLite lock/error during a2_deal_ledger insert), trade_memory remains committed (1 row) with post_fill_within_budget=True while a2_deal_ledger has 0 rows and process_broker_fill_response() returns recorded=False.

fix5_durable_post_fill_lock.finding: When a within-budget fill succeeds in SQLite (TradeMemoryService.record_trade() records post_fill_within_budget=True) while flat-file writes to a2_leg_state_{id}.json and a2_post_fill_incidents_{id}.jsonl fail (e.g. transient filesystem/permission error in Probe C), the halt state is NOT recorded in SQLite. On process restart, reconcile_or_initialize_a2_leg_state() sees no state file, no incident file, and post_fill_within_budget=True in TradeMemoryService, so it reconstructs state='CONFIRMED_FILLED' with new_entries_disabled=False, silently clearing the post-fill persistence failure lock.
